# rmux 0.1.14
Themes now apply to the entire rmux window, including the sidebar, tabs, command palette, menus and Settings.
- All seven built-in themes are supported, including Solarized Dark and Solarized Light. Imported themes and explicit color overrides also style the surrounding interface. - Theme changes apply live across windows, with matching selection, border and accent colors and readable text in light and dark themes. - Settings, Notifications and Memory replace one another consistently and preserve the terminal return-focus target. - An invalid external-editor setting no longer prevents startup. rmux disables that optional editor and displays repair guidance without changing the configuration file. - Browser-demo palette search uses the same field-aware matching as the native app.
## Downloads
GitHub builds the signed and notarized macOS Apple Silicon DMG and ZIP, Linux x86-64 tarball, and Windows x86-64 ZIP. macOS updates use Sparkle.
Focused theme/contrast and editor-recovery tests passed. Native review covered Catppuccin Latte, light palette input, and live switching to Nord. Shared WASM compilation passed. Windows runtime validation remains deferred.
[User guide](https://github.com/rmuxapp/rmux/blob/main/docs/user-guide.md) · [Website](https://rmux.app)
